description: This file defines the `AttendanceRecord` class in the OrangeHRM system, representing an employee's attendance entry with properties such as punch-in and punch-out times, notes, time zones, and status. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and mutating its properties.

classes.name: AttendanceRecord
classes.description: Represents an attendance record for an employee, including punch-in and punch-out details, time zones, and status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attendance record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attendance record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the associated Employee object.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee object with this attendance record.

methods.name: getPunchInUtcTime
methods.description: Retrieves the UTC time when the employee punched in.

methods.name: setPunchInUtcTime
methods.description: Sets the UTC punch-in time.

methods.name: getPunchInNote
methods.description: Gets any note attached to the punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInNote
methods.description: Sets a note for the punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchInTimeOffset
methods.description: Returns the time offset at punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the punch-in time offset.

methods.name: getPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user-local time of punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Sets the user-local punch-in time.

methods.name: getPunchOutUtcTime
methods.description: Retrieves the UTC time when the employee punched out.

methods.name: setPunchOutUtcTime
methods.description: Sets the punch-out UTC time.

methods.name: getPunchOutNote
methods.description: Gets any note attached to the punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutNote
methods.description: Sets a note for the punch-out.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimeOffset
methods.description: Returns the time offset at punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the punch-out time offset.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user-local time of punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Sets the user-local punch-out time.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state/status of the attendance record.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state/status.

methods.name: getPunchInTimezoneName
methods.description: Returns the timezone name at punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInTimezoneName
methods.description: Sets the timezone name at punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimezoneName
methods.description: Returns the timezone name at punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutTimezoneName
methods.description: Sets the timezone name at punch-out.
